card.name: Spaces and commas after fibrate drug names
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a space right after a lipid-drug name such as gemfibrozil, bezafibrate, clofibrate or orlistat, where a dose number or another drug name comes next. It also fires on a space before a number in dose text.

modes.label: After fibrate or lipid drug
modes.description: A comma, semicolon or space directly after a fibrate or lipid-lowering drug name.

modes.label: Before a dose number
modes.description: A space just before a dose figure in dosing or study text.

card.writes: It pushes against lipid-related word starts such as lip, HDL and LDL, so the next piece is unlikely to be a lipid term.
card.plain: It marks the gap right after a fibrate or similar drug name, just before a dose or the next drug in a list.
